observations: Photo 0: a stack of six paperback books shown by their spines only.

Spine titles readable in photo 0, top to bottom: 'Rich Dad Poor Dad' Robert T. Kiyosaki (partly hidden); 'This Is Marketing' Seth Godin with a Penguin Business logo; 'Sell Like Crazy' Sabri Suby; 'Crushing It!' Gary Vaynerchuk with a Harper Business logo; 'Guerrilla Marketing' Jay Conrad Levinson, Houghton Mifflin; 'Sell or Be Sold' Grant Cardone.
Spines look clean, colours sharp, no visible creasing or fading on the spines shown.
Watermark 'GLOBAL SPORTS AND BOOKS, POSTED ON JIJI' over the photo, a dealer's watermark.
No photo of covers, back covers, barcodes, copyright pages, page edges or the inside pages.
It is not clear whether the six are sold together or each separately.

identity.kind: set of 6 marketing and sales paperback books (Rich Dad Poor Dad, This Is Marketing, Sell Like Crazy, Crushing It!, Guerrilla Marketing, Sell or Be Sold)

claims.claim: Selected collection of books on marketing and sales
claims.evidence: Photo 0 spines show six business, marketing and sales titles.

claims.claim: Original copies, not photocopies or local reprints
claims.evidence: Spines alone cannot separate originals from good local reprints; publisher logos on spines are copied by reprinters. Needs copyright page, back cover barcode and paper close-up.

risks.risk: Books are local reprints or photocopies rather than original publisher editions.
risks.proof: For each book, a photo of the copyright page and the back cover barcode, plus a close-up of text print sharpness and paper.

risks.risk: Writing, highlighting, water damage or loose pages inside.
risks.proof: Short clip flipping through each book with the page edges and a few spreads visible.
risks.if_unproven: as worn used copies with markings

risks.risk: The listing is per book, not the six together, or fewer than six are available.
risks.proof: Seller confirmation and one photo of all six front covers laid out with a handwritten code and date in shot.
risks.if_unproven: as the six spines shown, each a used reprint

proof_requests: Photo of all six front covers laid out together with a handwritten code and today's date in shot.
Copyright page and back cover barcode of each book.
Clip flipping through each book to show the inside pages are unmarked.
response.reason: Six marketing and sales paperbacks are readable on their spines in photo 0, so the set can be priced at its worst case as used local reprints. Copyright pages, barcodes and a flip-through would raise it to originals in clean condition.
